postgres.purpose: Store desktop application templates and build history

redis.purpose: Cache compiled applications and build artifacts

agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Desktop generation and smoke testing remain available; only agent-assisted pipeline investigations and remediation suggestions are unavailable until Agent Manager is healthy.
agent-manager.description: Agent orchestration layer for pipeline investigations

deployment-manager.degraded_behavior: Proxy-mode desktop generation remains available; bundled-runtime manifest generation is unavailable until Deployment Manager is healthy.
deployment-manager.purpose: Bundle manifest generation for bundled runtime mode
deployment-manager.runtime_only_rationale: Scenario-to-desktop requests bundled-runtime manifests from Deployment Manager through its external CLI/service boundary; it does not import Deployment Manager code.

vrooli-bridge.degraded_behavior: Local desktop validation remains available; remote bridge targets are unavailable until Vrooli Bridge is healthy and configured.
vrooli-bridge.purpose: Discover and dispatch validation cells to trusted remote bridge targets
vrooli-bridge.runtime_only_rationale: Scenario-to-desktop uses Vrooli Bridge through its typed service transport for optional remote target inventory and dispatch; it does not import bridge implementation code.

descriptors.label: LPBS service identity
descriptors.description: Shared LPBS service identity resolved by scenario-to-desktop through the credential authority.

descriptors.label: Deployment Manager owner service token
descriptors.description: Short-lived scenario-to-desktop service credential with only the Deployment Manager preparation, readiness-evidence, and client-receipt scopes.

descriptors.label: Windows certificate password
descriptors.description: Optional password consumed by electron-builder for Windows code signing.

descriptors.label: Windows signing certificate
descriptors.description: Operator-managed PFX/P12 certificate path used by electron-builder for Windows code signing; the private certificate material is never bundled.

descriptors.label: Apple ID
descriptors.description: Optional Apple account consumed by electron-builder for notarization.

descriptors.label: Apple app-specific password
descriptors.description: Optional Apple app-specific password consumed by electron-builder for notarization.

descriptors.label: Apple API key file
descriptors.description: Optional Apple API key file consumed by electron-builder for notarization.

descriptors.label: Apple API key ID
descriptors.description: Public App Store Connect API key identifier paired with the private .p8 key file for notarization.

descriptors.label: Apple API issuer ID
descriptors.description: Public App Store Connect issuer identifier paired with the private .p8 key file for notarization.

descriptors.label: Linux GPG signing key
descriptors.description: GPG secret-key identity or fingerprint selected for Linux package signing on the signing host.

descriptors.label: Linux GPG passphrase
descriptors.description: Optional passphrase for the selected GPG signing key, supplied through the operator-selected environment variable and never stored in signing configuration.

logs.rationale: Scenario operational logs observed in the canonical logs directory.

budget.rationale: Regenerable storage is retained for 30 days and reclaimed by age; the window is the workload retention requirement.

runtime.rationale: Scenario runtime artifacts observed in the canonical runtime directory.

Retain recent reproducible evidence within an explicit capacity ceiling; the owner protects live work and removes oldest eligible entries when either bound is exceeded.

staging.rationale: Owner-managed reproducible artifacts; configurable age and byte bounds with live-work protection.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

tier-1-local.notes: Optional accelerator that no Go code in this scenario currently opens. The declaration records intended caching, not a runtime requirement.

tier-2-desktop.reason: No vendorable cross-platform RESP server exists
tier-2-desktop.notes: The scenario does not require Redis, so the desktop tier simply runs without it rather than shipping a server.

swappable_with.notes: A durable local store behind the same Store seam preserves the durability property across restart, but not cross-replica sharing. A deployment running more than one replica still needs a real Redis.
